# Character Visual Canon

## Common Rules
- Use the Approved Visual Anchor as the authoritative generation parent for the fixture subject.
- Do not reconstruct fixture identity from assistant memory, unrelated references, or prior Candidates.

## Fixture Subject

### Approved Visual Anchor

- `docs/visual/assets/fixture-subject-anchor.png`

### Accepted Visual Conditions

- Adult fictional test subject.
- Stable facial identity and proportions.

### Forbidden Changes

- Do not change subject identity.
- Do not substitute another subject or reference image.
